notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.lead: The address may have a typo, or the page has moved.

failed.title: Something went wrong
failed.lead: Try again. If it keeps happening, reload the page.
failed.changed: This has already changed. Look again.

login.title: Log in to {brand} Admin
login.codeHint: The 6 digits in your authenticator app, or a recovery code.

setup.passwordLead: Your login is {login}. Choose a password of at least {min} characters.
setup.appLead: Scan the code with the app, or type the key in, then type the 6 digits it shows.
setup.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
setup.codesLead: Each one signs you in once if you lose your phone. They won't be shown again.

account.recoveryLead: You have {left} left. New codes replace them all.
account.recoveryDone: Save these codes. They won't be shown again.

business.title: Business
business.counts: {services, plural, one {# service} other {# services}} · {team, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
business.noteMoved: It moved on {when}. Check the new address.
business.draft: Its owner is still setting it up, so there's nothing to decide yet.
business.noVerify: Nothing is verified while the sign-in code shows on the screen.
business.moveChecked: The new address of {name} is checked
business.rejectLead: Its owner reads your reason and can fix it and send it again.
business.rejectLiveLead: It leaves the site. Its owner reads your reason and can fix it and send it again.
business.reasonHint: Its owner reads this as you write it.
business.hideLead: It leaves search and its page closes to visitors. Its owner reads your reason.
business.closed: {name} is closed. {cancelled, plural, =0 {No bookings were ahead.} one {# booking was cancelled.} other {# bookings were cancelled.}}
business.closeLead: Only when its owner asks. Bookings ahead are cancelled with an SMS to each client, the page closes and the data stays.

addBusiness.title: Add a business
addBusiness.lead: For an owner you've met. It's a draft on their phone: when they sign in, they carry on from the next step.
addBusiness.name: Business name
addBusiness.ownerPhoneHint: They sign in with this number.

reviews.title: Reported reviews

reasons.fake: False, or the person didn't come

reviews.countsAgain: Decide by {when}: after that it counts in the rating again.
reviews.countedAgain: Past 48 hours: it counts in the rating again until you decide.
reviews.kept: Kept: it counts in the rating, and it can't be reported again
reviews.removeLead: It leaves the page and every count. The business hears the result; the author isn't told.
reviews.reasonHint: Kept with the review for the team.

team.title: Team
team.resetLead: Their password, authenticator, recovery codes and sessions go, and they set up again from a new link.
team.disableLead: They can't sign in and their sessions end. A new setup link brings them back.
team.loginHint: 3–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dots and dashes.
team.name: Name
team.linkLead: Hand this over in person or in a private message. It works for 24 hours and won't be shown again.
